verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships an official, documented CLI (probe confirms docs at /docs/iac/cli/). Documented commands include `pulumi preview`, `pulumi preview --import-file`, `pulumi import`, `pulumi do` direct resource operations, and calling the Pulumi Cloud REST API from the CLI. Missing for 10: no evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable/JSON output or non-interactive modes aimed at AI workflows, and no independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use by agents.
